notes.title: Inward Dev Update : Create your Trees
notes.notes:
Hello Friends, here is a quick overview of how you create and grow trees in Inward. Straight to it! Here is the video:

[previewyoutube=npTLk6G6tUE;full][/previewyoutube]

Grow and Create your Own Tree Species
You can create your own tree species by selecting a variety of elements, such as the type of leaves and the bark material. At launch, the tree system will have over 75,000 tree species to be discovered and grown.

Discover Trees Together
Inward’s trees will be grown together by the community of players. If you are the first to discover a tree species, then that type of tree will forever be linked to you, and other players will see this link.

Inward - Wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1545430/Inward_Journey/

https://emailoctopus.com/lists/da4aab1e-4394-11eb-a3d0-06b4694bee2a/forms/subscribe

www.patreon.com/krishs

notes.title: Biomes + VR Update Released
notes.notes:
Hello Friends,

I'm really excited to release one of the most significant updates for Playne so far that brings biomes and many improvements for VR.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32875930/f906ea55f3333f88a7a1048b80327525a9d480e5.jpg

Biomes😄 

 Grow new species of trees for Story, Sandbox and Evolve modes
 Three new species of trees: Aspen, Beech and Lombardy Poplar
 Completed Playne? Create multiple instances and start the journey again
 Choose trees that grow at different rates


Improvements & Fixes

 Torch that illuminate the ground to help you plant seeds at night in Sandbox mode.
 Many typos have been fixed. 👊 Huge thanks to those of you that sent me details of typos in the game. 
 Birds now tweet again during the day 🤷🏽‍♂️ 
 Better, more realistic water
 Steam Cloud save load quota increased to accommodate bigger saves
 Various other minor bug fixes


 VR Fixes and Improvements

 Full graphics overhaul and engine tweaks. Game should be crisper, performance should be better.
 New tutorial system gives you better onboarding onto Playne VR
 New dialogue interaction system for Fox. You will no longer need to walk around the fox to get the best angle so you can read the dialogue window (🤦🏽‍♂️ what was I thinking? part I)
 Game controls rethink and redesign. Gone are the complicated grip system for the weather and time power (🤦🏽‍♂️what was I thinking? part II)
 Planting controls rethink and redesign. You no longer need to actually touch the ground to plant the seeds (🤦🏽‍♂️what was I thinking? part III)
 Sandbox seed view needs less hand turn 
 New weather and time UI
 Cosmos and G2 controller added, although still not officially supported until a few of you can confirm that they work 🤷🏽‍♂️
 New, dare I say more beautiful, main menu
[*[ Better, clearer settings ui
 Better laser that doesn't shoot beyond the menu + full laser pointer system
 Grip should no longer interfere with interactions on Index


Gameplay Changes

 Sandbox and Story mode will no longer grow together. You now need to choose which biome/game mode you want to grow by meditating there. However you will still earn seeds for sandbox mode when you meditate in story mode.
 The original tree in Playne now grows in 60 days, about twice as fast as before. I've reduced this since you can now grow multiple biomes.
 

New Bug Tracking and Feature Request System
You can add, comment and vote on bug reports and feature requests. 👍 ??
Playne: https://vismaya.upvoty.com/b/playne/
Playne VR: https://vismaya.upvoty.com/b/playne-vr/

Big thanks to my Patreons:
💖 G'ma, 💖 AcidOxidant, 💖 Barbara Weitbrecht, 💖 Erzhena Soktoeva, 💖 Holger, 💖 Jesse Hutchison, 💖 John Hounihan, 💖 Juan Fassone, 💖 Karl, 💖 Matt Gray, 💖 Maxime Attimont, 💖 Meditation Mind, 💖 Michelle Roberts, 💖 pitgamer, 💖 za7ch, 💖 Agelorus, 💖 Elizabeth Parks, 💖 Rodney Armand, 💖 Christian BÃ¶ning, 💖 Jesus Redondo, 💖 jussi, 💖 Kidjchai Yingsery, 💖 Konohura, 💖 Margaret Howe, 💖 Michiel Krol, 💖 Oliver Waegner,💖 Sasha Hernandez, 💖 VagrantFox.

Special Thanks
Special thanks to G'ma for being one of the first to plant over 1,000 trees in Playne and supporting me for such a long time on Patreon. Also, big thanks to KalisChilde and the other mods for looking over the Discord. Thanks also to all you folks who helped me with testing this update.

Translations
Translations are a bit sketchy at the moment on Playne, and this is my fault since I've had to either redraft or redo some of the text on each patch. I'm doing localisation with our translators next so hopefully we can get some of this cleaned up. Until this happens, I'm removing the official 'interface localised' classification on Steam.

Partners
Lastly, make sure you check out the partners channel on Payne's discord. There are some wonderful communities that we are partnered with, including  Meditation Mind, Safe in Our World and Guardians Mental Health.

notes.title: Update Released : A Better Fox
notes.notes:
Hello friends,

Thanks to everyone who’s supported Playne since its full release earlier this year. I’m so happy to see so many active daily players, exploring meditation with Playne.

I’d like to announce a brand new update, which  brings some significant upgrades to your guide, your mentor, your friend, the fox. As well as a number of other improvements. 

🦊Fox Upgrade: Improved Dialogue
Fully Enhanced Fox Script: Most of the dialogue of your fox guide has been augmented, redrafted and improved. A lot of effort has gone into making the instructions for meditation even clearer and easier to understand.
Better dialogue interface: Less cluttered dialogue window and more natural dialogue flow and connections.
🦊Fox Upgrade: Other Improvements
Fox encourages you: New event-driven dialogue system with over 20 new dialogue strands. What does this mean? Well, Fox will now nudge you with encouragement and enlighten/annoy you with its wisdom (you choose which!) 
Improved movement: Fox will now walk, trot and run to you! Animation glitches have also been removed, and transitions have been improved as well. 
Better dialogue screen: In Sandbox/Evolve Mode, the dialogue view has been improved. I can’t find another way to say it, apart from that it looks prettier.
🌳Sandbox improvements
Planting distance indicator: The crosshair on the HUD will now tell you when you are far enough away from a tree to plant a new seed. Frantically spamming the plant key is no longer needed :) 
Improved notifications: Better instructions to help you understand and get feedback on the planting system. Game instructions have also been added to the Pause menu for new players.
🛠️Other Fixes & Improvements
Grammar / Spelilng fixes. :- |
Escape menu no longer intrudes on the achievements window.
Better achievements UI .
Better lantern (the polygon-y look wasn’t great, was it?).
'Remove guide text' option now actually removes guide text in meditation.
Crosshair dot is bigger! Why did I think a pixel wide crosshair was a good idea?
More prominent quest guide text.
Reaching level cap is now indicated in progress menu.
The volume of the fire can now be adjusted.
Quotes no longer disappear in your second session.
Fox no longer get warped around objects.
Outline of interactable objects in Story Mode has been improved.
Notifications no longer disappear in Sandbox / Evolve Mode.
+Other minor fixes and improvements.
🌍Localisation Issues?
Due to the range of changes to the dialogue text, some existing  localisations might appear incomplete or broken. Our community translators are working on adding these localisation  (thank you!).  lI’ll release this as a patch as soon as it’s completed. 

Although Playne doesn’t officially support localization of game text, it's nice to have the translators who make the effort to bring Playne to countries that otherwise might not be able to experience it. 

If any of you would like to join our community translators and help me update the missing localisations,  then drop me an email at krish (at) playne.co. If you have already contacted me (and I haven’t been back in touch) don’t worry, I will reach out to you soon.

🌱Planting Trees
Well done to all of you who have unlocked Evolve Mode over the last few months, allowing us to plant one tree in real life for every player who did so. I’ll soon be announcing the details of trees planted as part of this!

💬Experiencing issues with this update?
I’ve had a group of volunteers who took the time to test this update (thank you!) But as a solo dev,  I don’t have a lot of different dev environments that I can test Playne on.

If you experience any issues or bugs, then let me know by posting on the discussion forum here on Steam.  You can also easily revert back to the previous version (Right click Playne on your Steam Library > Properties > BETAS and select branch LastRelease)

🙏Thank you!
Thanks to everyone who made the effort to let me know how I can improve Playne, as well as suggestions for improvement.

Special thanks to my Patreons for continuing to support me in making games like  Playne 🙏:
G'ma, Karl, Holger, pitgamer, Erzhena S, Jesse H, Matt G, Michelle R, John H, Christian B, The Damn Shames, za7ch, Meditation Mind, Rodney A, Nin C, Elizabeth P, Agelorus, Leslie S, Valoky L, Jussi, VagrantFox, Tomas Q.

Meditate anywhere in the Evolve map itself
Significant performance boost for Evolve mode

Bug fixes:
No longer keep levelling up on every meditation after end-game.Camera no longer moves between transitionsBirds / Aurora now appears correctlyAudio levels for separate ambience channels now work againCrickets now have heir own separate audio channel that is adjustable via settingsDay / Night time effects now switch in real-time as you change time (you need to unlock the time ability to do this)Emptiness map no longer shows the wrong thought ripplesOther various bug fixes

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32875930/a5773272fe3f603c2f56164ddca97115510b89ed.jpg

Hello Friends,

This is the full release of the preview update released a few weeks ago.

This update brings a range of new meditation and improvements. Details attached below:

New Guided Meditations and exercises

 Audio Guided Meditations: Three meditations to help you better understand and realise your emotions/feelings/sensations. 
 Breathing exercises: Learn breathing exercises to help achieve clarity and calm.
 Meditative Journaling: An exercises that allow you to openly express your thoughts and encourages you to remain in silence. 
 Fundamental Meditation Improvements: The core meditation in Playne now has audio guidance.

Breathing System Improvements:

 Breath Warm-up: All meditation now consist of a breath warm-up.
 Customise breathing speed and pattern: Each meditation now allows you to select your preferred breathing pattern.
 New breathing exercises: designed to teach you breathing that I hope will leave a lasting positive impact on your life.
 Better Breathing Interface: Breathing HUD and interface has been improved.

Other Fixes and Improvements:

 New dialogue strand to explore books/resources on happiness, building healthy habits and easing suffering.
 German now shows up (but check note below)
 Better loading screens.
 Better meditation summary.
 Better meditation menu that has more customisation options.
 Better pause menu.
 Birds should no longer appear at night time.
 Various bug fixes

Note about translations
Localisation in Playne is unofficial and its only possible thanks to individuals who are gracious enough to help me translate the massive amount of text voluntarily.

This update has a lot of new text and the translations will be getting added as and when the they are completed. This means you could experience untranslated text in the game if you are not using English. If you would like to help with localisation then please drop me an email to krish (at) playne.co.

Thank you all, hope you find this update beneficial.
Krish.

notes.notes:
Hello Friends,
CAMPFIRE MODES + MEDITATION BELLS

Habit Building Mode : Your campfire will be based on your streaks (as it is now)
Passive Mode: Your campfire is based on the number of days meditated and will never go out.
Meditation Bells: you can now select from 10 different meditation bells. The default bell was a bit loud and some of you got a little startled after your meditation. Sorry 🙄 

NEW LANGUAGES
Big big thank you everyone who voluntarily helped me to localise Playne 🙏 New languages have been added to this update:

German: Thank you Sarah
Spanish : Thank you Carlos
Portuguese: Thank you Mariana
Hungarian: Thank you Brechler

IMPROVEMENTS & BUG FIXES

Baby trees: Trees are more visible in the earlier levels.
I can't read this dood 🤷: You can now stop squinting your eyes. Dialogue UI now has bigger text
Bruh, this is empty?: Removing UI will now fully remove all text while meditating
Resolve Evolve Sounds? You can now adjust the volume for Evolve mode as well
Arg! Birds!: For those of you that found the birds in Playne a little grating, you can now quieten them or silence them all together :(
Massive trees: Trees no longer overgrow over the navigation items after completion of game(Thanks @gma). They still grow, but slower once you complete Playne (Thanks @disies)
Crickets: Cricket won’t just disappear after a minute — they will chirp away indefinitely. chirp chirp chirp.
Evolve unlocks : Evolve now unlocks correctly and on-time. Sorry for those of you that had to wait a day longer.
Random Stats: You can put down your pen and paper. Your GPU stats no longer show up on evolve.
Many typos: Including, Thunderstrom 🤣
+ many other minor fixes

FEEDBACK
Its so inspiring to read messages from players who are finding that Playne is having a positive impact on their lives. Thank you so much for sharing them. Also, keep the feedback coming, I do read all your messages. All the updates that have been done on Playne has been largely influenced by you guys and for that, I am grateful. 

Thank you friends. Have a wonderful week.
Krish.

notes.title: MASSIVE UPDATE! - New Levelling System + End Game Unlocks + More
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875930/3720924791ea6d8e38a2b6ffb7cc3cc76d2533de.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875930/463e63e0f77790fcd4678cc5fcda49bd37640e38.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875930/00595e7c4445fef91eb0e25727a8e052e6b8d99d.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875930/679fcc20a74fe47325bd26a1689163f74f7576f2.jpg

Hello Friends! 

We’ve got a range of updates for you including some big changes to the levelling system.

Fully Revamped Progress System
The biggest change we wanted to implement was to move away from the punishing streak based levelling system.

 Day Based Levelling System: Each day you spend meditating will now progress you through the game. 
 two new skills added 
 New progress screen to track your level and the growth of playne 
 New screen for your track your streaks (campfire) 


 Dynamic Tree Growth 
The tree growth stages are now fully dynamic. 

Before we had a handful of separate growth stages as defined by your player level, but now you have a fully dynamic growth system. This means that your trees will grow on every single day of meditation.

 Visual upgrade 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875930/4e9dedb8b3db740d0e39a877714cc871c75d54f4.jpg
There are a bunch of new visuals added to the scene. The lighting has also been improved.

 Better Settings Widget 
Yup, you’ve asked for it and you now have it. A new settings system which makes it easier for you to control the different aspects of the game.


 Easier to navigate 
 You can also now toggle the meditation guide on and off 


 Interactable objects 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875930/ccdc5e0a9f6adf8f05bcd304196c2ed5059c31cf.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875930/4e9dedb8b3db740d0e39a877714cc871c75d54f4.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875930/00595e7c4445fef91eb0e25727a8e052e6b8d99d.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875930/ae5782e0c6756e10baf46490d60b7ffed5968813.jpg
You can now interact with objects in Playne to engage menus.

 End Game Unlock 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875930/679fcc20a74fe47325bd26a1689163f74f7576f2.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875930/733d6c592fc50a160a207a4828223c964852e10b.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875930/1df35a946323f5c53108342d030cdd468a5faa4c.jpg
Evolve mode is now an end game unlock.

 Walk around 4 sq km of an island inspired by Scotland.
 Collect seeds from the 'Last Tree'
 Plant seeds
 Meditate to make the seeds grow into tree.
 Trees grow into your forest
 Create your tranquil space
 All players who helped Beta test Evolve will have the mode unlocked


Bug Fixes

A lot more quotes for the meditation summary screen 
 Console has been fixed. (Commands are Sanugia for our old bugged out cam, 711 to remove UI. More coming soon with mentions to our players who have helped with bug fixing Playne :)
 VR loading unintentionally
 Text mismatch on meditation level up 
 Escape menu no longer loads on title screen 
 Start button now works on the dialogue screen 
 Bunch of typos fixed and other improvements to story tree 


Evolve Bug Fixes

Mismatched time tracking should be fixed
 Unstuck key to get yourself unstuck 


 Current Players Please Note 
Since the levelling system has been changes you might notice that your Playne has evolved further than the last time you played. If you have any other problems related to this upgrade then drop us a note on the discussion boards or email us at hello@playne.co
